chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn Asbāṭ, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, from Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام.
Regarding the saying of Allah, Mighty and Majestic:
And whoever obeys Allah and His Messenger in the wilayah of ʿAlī and the wilayah of the Imams after him has indeed attained a mighty success.
This is how it was revealed.

key_terms.الْأَئِمَّةِ: the Imams after Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام, named here as the locus of wilayah
key_terms.يُطِعِ: obeys, in the sense of compliant submission to divine command

ai.seo_question: How is Qur'an 33:71 understood in relation to the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Imams?
ai.summary: This report presents the verse as referring specifically to obedience to Allah and His Messenger in the matter of the wilayah of Imam ʿAlī عليه السلام and the Imams after him. Its significance in Shia tradition is that it frames true success as being tied to acceptance of divinely appointed authority.
